text: @vibeinging/dsh-red-alert 是面向 DSH Web 的红警 2 即时战略游戏插件，可在 Chat 中创建真实浏览器对局并由 Agent 通过分组工具观察战场和下达命令。它挂载 DSH 工具与右侧战场界面，支持地图与单位观察、生产和建造操作、批量微操，以及战后复盘形成后续策略。适合希望让 Agent 参与可视化 RTS 对局并在会话中检查行动的用户。运行需要自行提供游戏资源；资源导入由用户确认后从配置的下载地址获取。

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert adds Red Alert 2 to DSH Web. Agents start browser matches, inspect visible battlefield state, manage production, and issue batched unit orders. Post-match reviews can inform later strategy. Users supply game resources and confirm before importing.
想让 DSH 里的 Agent 指挥一场红警 2 对局。
能不能在 Chat 旁边显示实时 RTS 战场？
我想让模型查看战场后安排生产和建造。
帮我把多个单位的移动或集火指令一次下达。
希望 Agent 只能根据当前可见的敌情做战术决策。
怎么让模型在对局结束后总结经验并用于下一局？
I want an AI agent to play a visual Red Alert 2 match in DSH.
Can my DSH agent inspect a battlefield and issue RTS commands?
I need to batch movement and focus-fire orders for game units.
How can an agent learn bounded strategy lessons between matches?
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert 功能「创建浏览器对局」：通过会话工具创建一场浏览器红警对局，并返回第一份可见态势；可指定地图、阵营、对手数量和速度。
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert 功能「观察并指挥战场」：读取当前对局的可见信息，并以批次提交单位移动、攻击、撤退或部署命令。
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert 功能「对局复盘与策略」：对局自然结束后，模型可采纳或拒绝有限的经验候选；之后按地图、阵营和对手类型读取策略摘要。
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert feature “Import”: Users confirm, download, verify, or clear game resources in the browser.
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert 使用前须知：游戏运行资源需要由用户自行提供；内置资源导入控件在确认后下载归档，并写入浏览器 Cache Storage。
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert note: Game assets are not bundled; users confirm before importing them into browser storage.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · DSH Red Alert：[简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

运行在真实红警 2 引擎上的 AI 战场沙盘。让 DeepSeek 在战争迷雾下建基地、侦察、调兵、交战、失败、复盘，再把有证据的经验带入下一局。

这不是截图识别，不是 Canvas 战术图，也不是藏在后台的 headless 模拟。中间是 DSH 原生 Chat，模型的判断、工具调用和战报持续可见；右边是同一浏览器实例、同一座战场、同一个 AI 席位正在运行的真实红警 2 兼容客户端。用户随时可以在 Chat 里插入命令，改变下一步指挥。

如果你想看 Agent 不只“回答问题”，而是在真实规则、战争迷雾和失败代价下持续行动，这可能是 DSH 里最直观、最好玩的 AI 战场沙盘。

上图是完整 DSH 页面：左侧 session，中间模型判断，右侧真实游戏画面。截图来自使用者自行提供本地 RA2 资源的实战；仓库不包含游戏素材。

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 它为什么好玩：- 看得到思考：模型每轮的态势判断、生产计划、批量命令和工具回执都留在 Chat。
- 能直接干预：输入“先守住第一波”“保持两个矿车”或“暂停扩张，出三辆坦克”，用户命令会进入后续指挥上下文。
- 输赢都是真的：经济、电力、建造队列、寻路、交火、战争迷雾和结算都来自右侧真实客户端。
- 不是一次一条慢慢点：一个工具调用可以批量下达多单位命令，精确回执同时带回最新战场摘要，减少重复观察。
- 微操真的是模型在做：插件不会在后台替模型选目标、撤退或发动进攻；模型从 Chat 中可见的公平快照亲自拆分编队，并在一个批次中同时下达集火、拉扯、侦察和推进命令。
- 会把失败变成规则：自然终局后生成结构化 episode，模型采用或拒绝候选经验；下一局按地图、阵营和对手取回短策略。
- 公平但不迟钝：模型只看本方、当前视野敌人和冻结的最后发现记录，不读隐藏敌军，却可以比人更稳定地检查队列和并行安排动作。

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 一分钟开始：需要 Node.js 22.19 以上、pnpm 和 Git。本插件只适配当前最新版 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2`，不兼容旧版 DSH。NPM consumer 已用 pnpm 8.15.3 完整实测；仓库源码开发仍由 `packageManager` 锁定 pnpm 11.7.0。首次准备兼容客户端时，setup 会通过 `pnpm dlx` 使用精确锁定的 Bun，不要求全局安装 Bun。

```sh
mkdir dsh-red-alert-play
cd dsh-red-alert-play
pnpm init
pnpm add @vibeinging/dsh-red-alert@0.1.3 @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 一分钟开始：`dsh-red-alert-setup` 会检查环境、准备锁定的兼容客户端、把已发布插件挂载到 DSH Web Profile，并验证最终配置。`--download-resources` 表示你明确授权 setup 从下方写明的固定地址下载资源；命令会校验固定大小和 SHA-256，再保存到 `$DSH_HOME/red-alert/renderer-v5/dist`。第一次打开兼容客户端时，它会静音启动并自动导入这份已经验证的本地归档，正在等待的建局会继续执行，不需要处理音频授权弹窗、找文件选择器、返回 Chat 告诉模型或重新建局。首次导入、解压和客户端启动可能持续数分钟，所以首次建局单独等待最多 10 分钟；普通战术命令仍是 120 秒。等待期间不要重复提交建局。以后只需运行 `pnpm exec dsh-red-alert`。启动器始终强制使用 `--no-open`，只在终端打印 DSH 地址，绝不会自动新建浏览器标签；请手动打开或复用同一个 DSH 标签页。
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 一分钟开始：公开 NPM 包和 GitHub 仓库都不包含游戏美术、声音或地图素材。setup 的下载动作只在命令明确带有 `--download-resources` 时发生；你仍需自行确认有权获取和使用这份第三方资源。

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · DSH 已经启动，怎么玩：DSH 的 Profile 插件和红警 renderer 环境在进程启动时加载，不能热插入当前已经运行的进程。你的 Profile、会话、设置和 `$DSH_HOME/.env` 都会保留；只需要按当前状态处理一次：

| 当前状态 | 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| 还没有运行过 `dsh-red-alert-setup` | 停止当前 DSH，在安装本包的目录运行 setup，再用红警启动器启动 |
| 已经 setup，但当前是用 `dsh web` 或 `dsh --profile web` 启动 | 停止一次，然后改用 `pnpm exec dsh-red-alert` 启动 |
| 当前就是用 `pnpm exec dsh-red-alert` 启动 | 不需要重启，直接打开它输出的 DSH 地址并新建 Chat |

最常见的接入方式是：

```sh

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 先在原终端按 Ctrl+C 停止当前 DSH：cd dsh-red-alert-play
pnpm add @vibeinging/dsh-red-alert@0.1.3 @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2
pnpm exec dsh-red-alert-setup --profile web --download-resources
pnpm exec dsh-red-alert
```

如果旧版启动时报“需要设置 `RA_ASSETS_DIR`”，不要创建或填写这个内部变量。它是 0.1.1 在没有红警启动环境时给出的错误提示，不代表缺少用户游戏素材。执行上面的升级和 setup 命令即可；0.1.2 及后续版本会直接说明需要停止 DSH、运行 setup，再改用红警启动器。

如果 setup 已带 `--download-resources` 并通过完整性校验，第一次建局会自动导入资源并继续；不再要求用户寻找弹出的窗口、手动选文件、回到 Chat 报告完成或让模型重试。首次加载可能持续数分钟，在右栏出现真实战场或明确错误前不要重复提交。之后可以在中间看到模型判断和工具回执，在右侧观看同一局真实战场；也可以随时输入“先守住”“补两个矿车”或“集中进攻”等命令，插入下一轮指挥。

text:
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 先在原终端按 Ctrl+C 停止当前 DSH：对局运行时可以在右侧游戏画面按住鼠标左键拖动镜头、点击或拖动小地图定位，也可以使用方向键和滚轮。嵌入 DSH 后这些输入只改变观战镜头，不会选兵、生产或替模型下达战斗命令；真正的游戏命令仍来自 Chat 中可审计的模型工具调用。

如果右栏在正在创建或运行的对局中显示 `live Connection` 错误，不要重复运行启动命令，也不要继续打开新页面。确认终端已经输出同一个 DSH 地址后，只刷新当前 DSH 标签页，再点击一次“重试连接本地 renderer”。如果右栏显示“上一局已经结束”，不要重连旧终局；直接在当前 Chat 输入“复盘后继续下一局”。模型会使用复盘返回的策略、创建新的 `matchId`，页面也会切到全新的真实游戏画面。只有首次建局等待满 10 分钟后仍显示 `browser command receipt timed out`，才新建 Chat 重试。

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 资源下载地址与本地备用：如果不希望使用该地址，去掉 `--download-resources`。右侧战场仍会显示本地归档入口；选择你自己有权使用的归档即可。已验证的最小归档只需要：

- `RA2.MIX`
- `LANGUAGE.MIX`
- `MULTI.MIX`

音乐、Taunts、电影、`exe` 和 `dll` 不需要进入最小归档。浏览器会把导入结果保存在稳定的 renderer 源空间，后续启动可直接复用。自动下载的原始归档留在本机 `$DSH_HOME`；本地选择的归档不会被复制进 NPM 包、GitHub 仓库或 DSH 源码目录。

自动归档存在且摘要正确时，兼容客户端只会自动接受 renderer 自己的固定同源路径；第三方 URL、其他端口、查询参数和散列都不能触发自动导入。如果本地归档不存在或首次导入失败，自动路径只尝试一次，随后回到可见的本地文件入口。安装器保存的稳定本地端口保证后续启动复用同一个浏览器资源空间。若该端口被别的程序占用，请重新运行 setup，或用 `--renderer-port <空闲端口>` 明确选择。

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 直接这样指挥：在 DSH Chat 中使用自然语言即可，例如：

```text
创建一局苏军对普通 AI，速度 2。开局前读取苏军建筑和开局战场手册，自动打完并复盘。

先守住第一波，保持两个矿车，再转三辆犀牛坦克。

模型会先按需加载开局或学习工具，再随着阶段进入观察、生产、建设和战斗工具。未加载的工具 schema 不进入模型上下文。

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 赛后不是一句“下次努力”：自动学习不训练或修改模型权重，也不保存自由文本提示。插件只从公平战场数据和已经准入的命令结果中计算封闭候选规则，记录证据，再由模型选择采用或拒绝。后续对局只取回少量、匹配当前地图和阵营的规则，避免经验无限堆进上下文。

速度 2 的三局连续实战已经证明经验能跨局保存并被下一局读取；该样本中前两局失败，第三局在 tick 24090 时仍存活并完成更完整的防御与装甲生产。它证明学习链路在工作，不证明当前策略已经达到稳定胜率。完整过程见[自动增强与连续对战报告](docs/reports/2026-08-23_auto-learning-speed2-and-command-cycle.md)。
section: 赛后不是一句“下次努力”

text:
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 内置战场手册，不再瞎猜代号：`strategy/learning` 组新增 `red_alert_field_manual`。模型可以在开局前只读取一个需要的主题：建筑、步兵、载具与空军、开局或交战；还可以按苏军、盟军或通用内容过滤。建筑和单位的代号、价格、前置条件来自 Red Alert 2 `rules.ini`，开局和交战规则来自公开战术资料与本插件的公平对局复盘。

手册明确区分 `NAWEAP/GAWEAP` 陆军战车工厂和 `NAYARD/GAYARD` 船厂，并给出基础兵种用途、三辆核心坦克、首轮反步兵防御、编队掩护、当前视野侦察与 last-seen 使用边界。每次查询的完整页面都会写入 session 日志；它只提供公开静态知识，不会带入敌方隐藏位置、经济或单位。
section: 内置战场手册，不再瞎猜代号

text:
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 真实战场，不作弊：Chat、工具、bridge、引擎和画面持续绑定同一个 `sessionId`、`matchId`、AI seat 和 tick。

模型可见敌情只有三类：

- `visibleEnemies`：当前真实视野内的敌人。
- `lastSeenEnemies`：敌人离开视野前最后一次合法观察；位置、生命值和 `observedAtTick` 在隐藏期间冻结。
- `visibleNeutralObjects`：当前真实视野内的中立对象。

模型不能访问敌方隐藏出生点、敌方经济、全图对象、debug state、观察者视角、Canvas 像素或未过滤的引擎对象。renderer 和模型 bridge 共用当前 LOS 规则；建筑放置也只在当前视野内搜索合法地基。

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 一套游戏能力，按阶段加载：引擎的 85 个公开声明全部进入 `METHOD_POLICY`。允许能力和插件自有学习能力由 22 个精确 manifest 项覆盖；危险方法保持不可见。初始只注册两个 bootstrap 工具：

| 组 | 主要能力 |
| --- | --- |
| `bootstrap/capability` | 发现能力、加载精确工具组 |
| `strategy/learning` | 按需战场手册、读取短策略、复盘和采用候选规则 |
| `lobby/setup` | 选地图、配置玩家、创建并开始对局 |
| `observation` | 公平观察、状态、地图、资源和规则 |
| `units/combat` | 单位移动、攻击、部署和批量命令 |
| `production/economy` | 目录、队列、生产、暂停和取消 |
| `construction` | 建筑目录、合法放置、维修和出售 |
| `diplomacy/comms` | 外交和通讯 |
| `superweapon` | 超级武器 |
| `lifecycle/replay` | 停止和结束对局 |

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · 安装器做什么，不做什么：```text
pnpm exec dsh-red-alert-setup --profile web --download-resources
  -> 检查 pnpm 和 dsh 0.1.1-rc.2

安装器失败时会停在真实失败点。若活动命令不是 `dsh 0.1.1-rc.2`，它会在改动 Profile 前退出。若你还没有可运行的 DSH Web Profile，最新版 DSH 会在第一次检查时创建默认 `web` Profile。setup 不要求全局 Bun；只有第一次构建 renderer 时才通过 `pnpm dlx bun@1.3.14` 下载并运行锁定工具，已经准备好的 renderer 不再检查 Git 或 Bun。资源下载会先校验响应声明的大小，再在流式写入时限制总字节数并计算 SHA-256；任何不一致都会删除未完成的 `.part` 文件并停止 setup，不会把错误内容交给客户端。

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · DSH Red Alert：[简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

An AI battlefield sandbox powered by a real Red Alert 2 engine. DeepSeek builds, scouts, commands armies, fights, loses, reviews the evidence, and carries bounded lessons into the next match under fog of war.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · DSH Red Alert：This is not screenshot interpretation, a Canvas tactical map, or a headless simulation hidden in the background. Native DSH Chat stays in the center, where the model's decisions, tool calls, and battle reports remain visible. A real Red Alert 2-compatible web client runs on the right in the same browser instance, on the same battlefield, and under the same AI seat. The user can enter a directive in Chat at any time and steer the next command cycle.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · DSH Red Alert：If you want to see an agent do more than answer questions and instead act continuously under real rules, fog of war, and meaningful defeat, this is one of the most direct and playable AI battlefield sandboxes for DSH.

The image shows the complete DSH page: sessions on the left, model decisions in the center, and the real game on the right. It comes from a live match using locally imported RA2 resources supplied by the user. The repository contains no game assets.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Why it is fun：- Watch the command logic: every tactical assessment, production plan, batch order, and tool receipt stays in Chat.
- Intervene at any time: directives such as "hold the first wave," "keep two harvesters," or "stop expanding and build three tanks" enter the next command context.
- Wins and losses are real: economy, power, build queues, pathfinding, combat, fog of war, and the result screen all come from the live client.
- Command more than one unit at a time: a single tool call can issue a batch of unit orders and return a fresh battlefield summary, reducing redundant observation turns.
- Let the model perform the micro: the plugin never selects a target, retreats a unit, or launches an attack in the background. The model splits exact units from its fair Chat-visible snapshot and can combine focus fire, kiting, scouting, and movement in one batch.
- Turn defeats into rules: a natural match ending creates a structured episode; the model accepts or rejects candidate lessons and retrieves a short strategy matched to the next map, faction, and opponent.
- Stay fair without becoming slow: the model sees its own forces, currently visible e

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Start in one minute：You need Node.js 22.19 or later, pnpm, and Git. This plugin supports only the current `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2` release, not older DSH versions. The NPM consumer path is fully verified with pnpm 8.15.3; source development remains pinned to pnpm 11.7.0 through `packageManager`. On the first compatible-client preparation, setup uses an exact Bun version through `pnpm dlx`; no global Bun installation is required.

mkdir dsh-red-alert-play
cd dsh-red-alert-play
pnpm init
pnpm add @vibeinging/dsh-red-alert@0.1.3 @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Start in one minute：`dsh-red-alert-setup` checks the environment, prepares the locked compatible client, mounts the published plugin into the DSH Web Profile, and verifies the final configuration. `--download-resources` explicitly authorizes setup to fetch the archive from the fixed address documented below. Setup verifies its exact size and SHA-256, then stores it under `$DSH_HOME/red-alert/renderer-v5/dist`. On first launch, the compatible client starts muted, imports that verified local archive automatically, and lets a waiting create-match continue. There is no audio-permission dialog, file-picker hunt, return-to-Chat handoff, or second create request. Initial import, extraction, and client startup may take several minutes, so create-match has its own 10-minute timeout while normal tactical commands retain the 120-second timeout. Do not submit another create request while it is pending. Later launches need only `pnpm exec dsh-red-alert`. The launcher always enforces `--no-open`: it prints the DSH address but never creates a browser tab. Open that address manually or reuse the same DSH tab.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Start in one minute：The public NPM package and GitHub repository contain no game art, sound, or map assets. Setup downloads nothing unless `--download-resources` is explicitly present. You remain responsible for confirming that you have the right to obtain and use the third-party archive.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Install from source：```sh
git clone https://github.com/vibeinging/dsh-red-alert.git
cd dsh-red-alert
pnpm run setup -- --profile web --download-resources
pnpm run dsh

Source mode additionally installs dependencies and builds the plugin. NPM mode uses the published Host, browser, and type artifacts directly and never tries to rebuild inside `node_modules`.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Resource download and local fallback：Automatic preparation uses the public candidate [`https://download.ra2web.com/full-pack.7z`](https://download.ra2web.com/full-pack.7z):

- Exact size: `140316786` bytes
- Exact SHA-256: `3119b300794839ab597df556df8718c0a0a28fe89648ddced1c3790d801cb646`
- Local destination: `$DSH_HOME/red-alert/renderer-v5/dist/dsh-red-alert-resource.7z`

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Resource download and local fallback：RA2WEB operates this address as a convenience source. Its availability does not grant rights from EA or any other rights holder to copy or distribute the assets. Setup prints the same source, size, digest, and rights notice before fetching. A download occurs only when the command explicitly includes `--download-resources`. The NPM package, GitHub repository, and compatible-client source do not contain the archive.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Resource download and local fallback：If you do not want to use this address, omit `--download-resources`. The battlefield keeps a visible local-archive fallback. Select an archive that you have the right to use. The verified minimum archive contains only:

- `RA2.MIX`
- `LANGUAGE.MIX`
- `MULTI.MIX`

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Resource download and local fallback：Music, Taunts, movies, executables, and DLLs are not required. The browser persists the imported result in the stable renderer origin for later launches. An automatically downloaded source archive stays under the local `$DSH_HOME`; a manually selected archive is not copied into the NPM package, GitHub repository, or a DSH source checkout.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Resource download and local fallback：When the verified archive exists, the compatible client auto-accepts only the renderer's fixed same-origin path. A third-party URL, another port, a query string, or a fragment cannot trigger automatic import. If the local archive is absent or the first import fails, the automatic path runs only once and then falls back to the visible local-file UI. The stable local port saved by setup keeps the same browser resource space on later launches. If another program owns that port, rerun setup or pass `--renderer-port <free-port>`.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Resource download and local fallback：After updating a source checkout, run the same setup command to verify the build and mount again:

```sh
git pull --ff-only
pnpm run setup -- --profile web --download-resources
```

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Command it like this：Use natural language in DSH Chat, for example:

```text
Create a Soviet match against a normal AI at speed 2. Read the Soviet structure and opening manual first, play to completion, and review the result.

Hold the first wave, keep two harvesters, then transition into three Rhino Tanks.

The model loads lobby or learning tools when they become relevant, then adds observation, production, construction, and combat tools as the match advances. Unloaded tool schemas do not enter the model context.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Post-match learning with evidence：Automatic learning does not train or modify model weights, and it does not store free-form prompts. The plugin derives a closed set of candidate rules only from fair battlefield data and accepted command results, records their evidence, and lets the model adopt or reject them. Later matches retrieve only a small set of rules matched to the current map and faction, preventing an unlimited history from filling the context window.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Post-match learning with evidence：A three-match series at speed 2 proves that lessons persist and can be retrieved by the next match. The first two matches ended in defeat; the third remained alive at tick 24090 with a more complete defense and armored production chain. This proves the learning path works, not that the current strategy has reached a stable win rate. See the [automatic improvement and match series report](docs/reports/2026-08-23_auto-learning-speed2-and-command-cycle.md) for the complete evidence.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · A built-in battlefield manual instead of guessed ids：The `strategy/learning` group now includes `red_alert_field_manual`. Before a match, the model can load only one needed topic: structures, infantry, vehicles and aircraft, openings, or combat. Results can be filtered to Soviet, Allied, or shared knowledge. Structure and unit ids, costs, and prerequisites come from Red Alert 2 `rules.ini`; opening and combat rules come from public strategy material and this plugin's fair match reviews.
section: A built-in battlefield manual instead of guessed ids

text: @vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · A built-in battlefield manual instead of guessed ids：The manual explicitly separates the `NAWEAP/GAWEAP` land war factories from the `NAYARD/GAYARD` shipyards. It also covers basic unit roles, the first three-tank group, early anti-infantry defense, combined-arms screens, current-vision scouting, and the limits of last-seen intelligence. Every returned page is written to the session log. The manual contains public static knowledge only and never adds hidden enemy positions, economy, or units.
section: A built-in battlefield manual instead of guessed ids

text:
@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · A real battlefield without cheating：Chat, tools, the bridge, the engine, and the renderer remain bound to the same `sessionId`, `matchId`, AI seat, and tick.

Enemy information reaches the model in only three forms:

- `visibleEnemies`: enemies inside current real vision.
- `lastSeenEnemies`: the final legal observation before an enemy leaves vision; position, health, and `observedAtTick` remain frozen while hidden.
- `visibleNeutralObjects`: neutral objects inside current real vision.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · A real battlefield without cheating：The model cannot access hidden enemy start positions, enemy economy, full-map objects, debug state, an observer view, Canvas pixels, or unfiltered engine objects. The renderer and model bridge use the same current-LOS rule. Construction placement searches only for legal foundations inside current vision.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Game capabilities loaded by phase：All 85 public engine declarations are classified in `METHOD_POLICY`. Twenty-two precise manifest entries cover allowed engine capabilities and plugin-owned learning operations; unsafe methods remain unavailable. A new session initially registers only two bootstrap tools:

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Game capabilities loaded by phase：| Group | Main capabilities |
| --- | --- |
| `bootstrap/capability` | Discover capabilities and load precise tool groups |
| `strategy/learning` | Load manual pages on demand, retrieve short strategies, review matches, and adopt candidate rules |
| `lobby/setup` | Select maps, configure players, create matches, and start games |
| `observation` | Fair observation, state, maps, resources, and rules |
| `units/combat` | Movement, attacks, deployment, and batch unit commands |
| `production/economy` | Catalogs, queues, production, pause, and cancellation |
| `construction` | Building catalogs, legal placement, repair, and selling |
| `diplomacy/comms` | Diplomacy and communication |
| `superweapon` | Superweapons |
| `lifecycle/replay` | Stop and end a match |

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Game capabilities loaded by phase：Every precise renderer tool returns a `commandView` containing the current tick, economy, power, owned units, visible enemies, and frozen last-seen records. The model can continue from the same receipt instead of reading the full state again before every action.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Game capabilities loaded by phase：`red_alert_unit_order` is an executor, not an AI. The real model chooses every target, group, retreat, and direction. The plugin only validates current owned ids, current-visible attack targets, and same-match identity, then executes the supplied `orders[]` in order. One call can contain several independent actions, so the model can retreat damaged armor, focus another group, and advance the main force in the same tactical cycle.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Game capabilities loaded by phase：`red_alert_start.gameSpeed` accepts values from 0 through 6. The default is speed 2, the original 15 ticks per second. Speed applies equally to both sides and the renderer and does not change model permissions. Profiles can override it with `defaultGameSpeed`.

section: What the installer does and does not do

text: @vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · What the installer does and does not do：The installer stops at the real failure point. If the active command is not `dsh 0.1.1-rc.2`, it exits before changing the Profile. If a Web Profile does not exist yet, the latest DSH release creates its default `web` Profile during the first check. Setup does not require global Bun: only the first renderer build downloads and runs the locked `pnpm dlx bun@1.3.14` tool, while a prepared renderer no longer checks Git or Bun. Resource preparation first checks the declared response length, enforces the byte limit while streaming, and calculates SHA-256. Any mismatch deletes the unfinished `.part` file and stops setup before the compatible client can receive the content.

@vibeinging/dsh-red-alert README · Project boundaries：- This is an independent external plugin built specifically for DeepSeek Harness. It mounts through the official NPM SDK, `cordis.patch.yml`, and Profile mechanisms without modifying DSH source.
- Pending commands do not promise cross-process exactly-once behavior after a browser or Host crash. Recovery fails closed instead of guessing whether a command ran.
- Without movie assets, the compatible client can report non-blocking video decoding warnings. Minimum resource import and real matches continue to work.
- Open-source compatible client code does not place EA art, sound, or map assets in the public domain. Users must confirm their resource source and usage rights.
- Plugin source and the NPM package use `GPL-3.0-only`; the compatible renderer adapter follows the same upstream GPLv3 license. The license grants no rights to EA game assets.
